symptom: PC cannot communicate with another PC in the same department.
topology_note: PC1 and PC2 are connected to SW1. PC1 should be in VLAN 10.
show_output: show vlan brief | VLAN 10 is not listed
expected_fix: Create VLAN 10 and assign the correct access ports.

symptom: PC receives an IP address but cannot communicate with devices in its VLAN.
topology_note: PC is connected to SW1 on FastEthernet0/5 and should belong to VLAN 20.
show_output: show vlan brief | Fa0/5 is assigned to VLAN 1 instead of VLAN 20
expected_fix: Assign FastEthernet0/5 to VLAN 20.

symptom: Trunk traffic for VLAN 30 is not reaching the second switch.
topology_note: SW1 and SW2 are connected using GigabitEthernet0/1. VLAN 30 must cross the trunk.
show_output: show interfaces trunk | Allowed VLANs: 10,20 | VLAN 30 missing
expected_fix: Allow VLAN 30 on the trunk.

symptom: Users in VLAN 40 lose connectivity after connecting to another switch.
topology_note: SW1 and SW2 use a trunk link and VLAN 40 is required on both switches.
show_output: show interfaces trunk | Trunking VLANs: 10,20,30 | VLAN 40 missing
expected_fix: Add VLAN 40 to the trunk allowed list.

symptom: PC can access local devices but cannot reach the remote server.
topology_note: PC is in 192.168.10.0/24 and router interface is 192.168.20.1.
expected_fix: Configure the gateway as an address in the PC's local subnet.

symptom: PC has an IP address but cannot reach any device outside its subnet.
topology_note: PC is in 192.168.20.0/24 and should use router gateway 192.168.20.1.
expected_fix: Change the default gateway to 192.168.20.1.

symptom: PC can communicate locally but remote network connectivity fails.
topology_note: PC belongs to VLAN 30 using network 10.30.0.0/24.
expected_fix: Set the default gateway to the router interface in 10.30.0.0/24.

symptom: Server is reachable from some hosts but not from its local network.
topology_note: Server uses 192.168.50.0/24 and router interface is 192.168.50.1.
show_output: show running-config | ip address 192.168.50.10 255.255.255.0 | default gateway configured as 192.168.60.1
expected_fix: Configure the server default gateway as 192.168.50.1.

symptom: PC automatically receives a 169.254.x.x address.
topology_note: PC is connected to a switch that should receive addresses from the router DHCP service.
show_output: ipconfig | IPv4 Address: 169.254.10.25 | DHCP Enabled: Yes
expected_fault: DHCP service not providing an address
expected_fix: Check DHCP pool configuration and DHCP reachability.

symptom: PC receives an address from the wrong network.
topology_note: VLAN 20 clients should receive addresses from the 192.168.20.0/24 DHCP pool.
show_output: show ip dhcp binding | 192.168.10.25 assigned to VLAN 20 client
expected_fix: Correct the DHCP pool network and VLAN configuration.

symptom: New clients cannot obtain IP addresses while existing clients continue working.
topology_note: Router provides DHCP for 192.168.30.0/24.
show_output: show ip dhcp pool | Network 192.168.30.0/24 | Total addresses 254 | Leased addresses 254
expected_fix: Increase available DHCP addresses or reduce unnecessary leases.

symptom: PC has no DHCP-assigned gateway information.
topology_note: PC should receive IP, mask, gateway and DNS from router DHCP.
show_output: show running-config | ip dhcp pool USERS | network 192.168.40.0 255.255.255.0 | no default-router
expected_next_command: show running-config | section ip dhcp pool
expected_fix: Add the correct default-router option to the DHCP pool.

symptom: PC can ping a web server by IP address but cannot access it using its hostname.
topology_note: PC uses an internal DNS server at 192.168.60.10.
show_output: ipconfig /all | DNS Servers: 0.0.0.0
expected_fix: Configure the correct DNS server address.

symptom: Hostname lookup fails but network connectivity to the DNS server works.
topology_note: DNS server is 192.168.70.10 and PC is in VLAN 70.
show_output: nslookup server.local | DNS request timed out | Server: Unknown
expected_fix: Verify DNS service, DNS server configuration and hostname record.

symptom: Users can reach external IP addresses but websites do not resolve.
topology_note: PC receives network settings through DHCP.
show_output: ipconfig /all | DNS Servers: 192.168.80.99 | Correct DNS server: 192.168.80.10
expected_fix: Change DNS configuration to the correct DNS server.

symptom: PC can ping its gateway but cannot reach the server network.
show_output: show ip route | C 192.168.10.0/24 is directly connected | No route for 192.168.20.0/24
expected_fix: Configure a route to 192.168.20.0/24.

symptom: Remote branch network cannot be reached from headquarters.
topology_note: HQ router must reach branch network 10.2.0.0/16 through 10.1.1.2.
show_output: show ip route 10.2.0.0 | % Network not in table
expected_fix: Add the appropriate static or dynamic route.

symptom: Traffic reaches the router but is sent toward the wrong network.
topology_note: Router connects to multiple remote networks.
expected_fix: Correct the static route and next-hop address.

symptom: One direction of communication works but return traffic fails.
topology_note: Two routers connect separate LANs and require bidirectional routing.
show_output: show ip route | Router A has route to 10.20.0.0/24 | Router B has no route to 10.10.0.0/24
expected_fix: Add the missing route on Router B.

symptom: Guest users cannot access the internal web server.
topology_note: Guest VLAN 100 should be denied access to internal resources except the public web service.
expected_fix: Review and correct the ACL rule order and permitted traffic.

symptom: Authorized management PC cannot access the router using SSH.
topology_note: Management network is 192.168.200.0/24.
show_output: show access-lists | deny tcp any any eq 22 | matches 12
expected_fix: Permit authorized management SSH traffic before the deny rule.

symptom: Ping works but application traffic is blocked.
topology_note: Client should access HTTP server on TCP port 80.
show_output: show access-lists | deny tcp 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 host 192.168.20.10 eq 80
expected_fix: Modify ACL to permit required HTTP traffic.

symptom: Users from the finance network cannot reach the shared server.
topology_note: Finance network is 192.168.30.0/24 and server is 192.168.40.10.
show_output: show access-lists | deny ip 192.168.30.0 0.0.0.255 host 192.168.40.10
expected_fix: Correct or remove the incorrect deny rule.

symptom: Inside PC can reach the router but cannot access the Internet.
topology_note: Router connects inside LAN 192.168.10.0/24 to ISP.
show_output: show ip nat translations | Pro Inside global: none | Pro Inside local: none
expected_fix: Verify NAT configuration, inside/outside interfaces and ACL.

symptom: Internet access fails for all internal clients.
topology_note: Inside network is 192.168.20.0/24.
show_output: show running-config | ip nat inside source list 10 interface GigabitEthernet0/0 overload | access-list 10 permit 192.168.30.0 0.0.0.255
expected_fault: NAT ACL does not match inside network
expected_fix: Correct the NAT ACL to permit the actual inside subnet.

symptom: Some internal hosts have Internet access but new subnet hosts do not.
topology_note: Router performs PAT for multiple internal networks.
show_output: show access-lists | 20 permit 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 | 192.168.20.0/24 missing
expected_fix: Add the required internal subnet to the NAT ACL.

symptom: Wireless client associates with the access point but cannot reach the gateway.
topology_note: AP serves VLAN 50 and wired switch trunk carries VLAN 50.
show_output: show interfaces trunk | Allowed VLANs: 10,20,30 | VLAN 50 missing
expected_fault: Wireless VLAN not allowed on trunk
expected_fix: Allow VLAN 50 on the AP trunk.

symptom: Wireless client connects to SSID but receives no IP address.
topology_note: Wireless clients should obtain DHCP addresses from VLAN 60.
show_output: show vlan brief | VLAN 60 absent
expected_fix: Create VLAN 60 and configure correct AP/switch VLAN mapping.

symptom: PC loses connectivity after a switch port configuration change.
topology_note: PC is connected to FastEthernet0/10.
show_output: show ip interface brief | FastEthernet0/10 | administratively down | down
expected_fix: Enable the interface with no shutdown.

symptom: Router interface is connected but remote network is unreachable.
topology_note: Router interface GigabitEthernet0/1 should connect to the upstream router.
show_output: show ip interface brief | GigabitEthernet0/1 | down | down
expected_fix: Check physical connection and enable/configure the interface.

symptom: PC can reach devices on its subnet but cannot reach the router.
topology_note: PC network is 172.16.10.0/24.
expected_fix: Set the gateway to the router interface in 172.16.10.0/24.

symptom: Server network is reachable from one router but not from another router.
topology_note: Three-router topology requires routes between all LANs.
show_output: show ip route 10.50.0.0 | % Network not in table
expected_fix: Add the missing route and verify end-to-end connectivity.
